ward.ward_name: Bandra East, Santacruz East, Khar East
ward.summary: Ward H/E (Bandra East, Santacruz East, Khar East) used ₹61.5 lakh of its ₹82.0 lakh budget, or 75%, so it stayed within budget across 111 jobs. About 26% of repairs were redone within 30 days, against an expected 27%, which is in line with expectations; ₹16.1 lakh went to repairs that failed. The ward is flood-prone (flood index 0.75), which makes repairs harder to keep in place. Eleven jobs are listed for billing review, and 17 jobs worth ₹9.0 lakh were paid on roads under warranty. Next, the ward should fund its 30 open issues, starting with Kalanagar Road, at a cost of ₹10.1 lakh. The remaining ₹20.5 lakh covers all of them.
